name: Dither
author: Erin Carter
description: An ordered Bayer dither over a slow folded gradient — chunky pixels stippling between a handful of palette levels the way an old indexed display would, the colour bands drifting and reshaping. Crisp, retro, low-bit.

params.label: Pixel size
params.effect: Size of the chunky dither pixels in css px; low is fine, high is blocky retro.

params.label: Levels
params.effect: How many quantisation levels the gradient is dithered into; low is stark, high is smooth.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: Drift speed of the underlying gradient; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Fold
params.effect: How much the gradient bends and folds; 0 is a clean linear ramp, high is turbulent.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer lifts the gradient toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
